selectionNote: Records 1-104 are the user-selected set. The accidental repeated 1-62 paste after item 104 was excluded. ECO-20260820-SPITZER-FULL-POPULATION-003: exhaustive research/enrichment pass. All 104 records retain original archive IDs, order, image URLs, source URLs, and titles. Viewer fields are populated with published values when available and clearly marked estimates/fallback framing where necessary.
